If you have seen his ship, the Vesper, please leave a blue lamp burning on All Saints’ Eve.” Elias had seen no wreck, but he remembered an old logbook in the attic. Whether the writer still watched the sea or not, someone deserved an answer.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台调低音量的机器。高架桥上，零星的出租车滑过，尾灯在湿气里拖出暗红的线。便利店的白光落在空荡街口，值班员靠着柜台打盹；环卫工推着车，把昨夜的纸杯与喧嚣一并收走。远处写字楼只剩几扇窗亮着，像未完成的句子。天边尚未泛白，第一班公交已驶出车站，载着困倦的人，也载着这座城即将醒来的呼吸。","w03":"- Recursion is when solving a problem means solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- You keep repeating that step until the problem becomes so tiny that you can answer it directly.\n- Then you use those small answers to build the answer to the original problem, like opening a stack of nested boxes."}
